summary: Earnings is the main event risk: eight names have an estimated report within 5 trading days (MCO and WDFC 10-21, SAM and VRSN 10-22, DORM 10-26, EXLS/INCY/LOGI 10-27), all on last-year+364d estimates, not confirmed dates. The only filing that needs a flag is SMG's 8-K 5.02 (officer change). Company-specific news is thin: an AAPL downgrade, a mixed MLI print, an MSCI beat and KR reaffirming guidance. For the ETF and crypto sleeves the macro picture is rates-heavy: 10y at 5.14%, Fed rate-hike odds in play, $110 Brent and Iran threatening undersea cables. BTC is recovering near $82-83k after a ~6% correction, with no exchange or regulatory shock.

notable.headline: Loop Capital Downgrades Apple to Hold, Lowers Price Target to $330
notable.read: A sell-side downgrade lands just as AAPL tops $5T. Upcoming catalysts: the Oct 28 event (touchscreen MacBook Pro, M6), strong iPhone Duo demand (82-day lead time), and earnings 10-29 or 11-02. There is also EU/UK regulatory pressure: the UK CMA wants contactless/NFC opened up, and Poland ordered changes to App Tracking Transparency. That pressure is incremental, not new.

notable.headline: Mueller Industries Q3 EPS $1.00 Misses $1.05 Estimate, Sales $1.419B Beat $1.285B Estimate
notable.read: A big revenue beat (+10% vs consensus) with an EPS miss suggests margin compression, probably from copper pass-through. That puts quality of earnings in question rather than demand.

notable.headline: MSCI Q3 Adj. EPS $5.11 Beats $5.02 Estimate, Sales $892.0M Beat $885.7M Estimate
notable.read: A clean, modest beat on both lines. Earnings risk is gone for now.

notable.headline: Kroger Sets 7%-11% Annual EPS Growth Target Through 2029, Reaffirms 2026 Outlook
notable.read: FY26 adj EPS guidance of $5.10-$5.30 brackets consensus ($5.21) and comes with new long-term targets (8-K 7.01). It lowers uncertainty and adds no surprise. A separate 10-17 story says a top US grocery chain's websites are offline after a cyber incident; the chain isn't named in the input, so check whether it is KR.

notable.headline: Why Is Walmart Stock in the Spotlight Tuesday?
notable.read: A Deutsche Bank upgrade, Evercore PT to $130 and BofA Buy/$126 (ad business), plus a $120/yr Walmart+/Sam's Club bundle. Sentiment is positive. Earnings are estimated for 11-19, so there is no near-term event risk.

notable.headline: JP Morgan Maintains Underweight on Clorox, Lowers Price Target to $83
notable.read: A bear stays bearish, with earnings estimated 11-02.

notable.headline: Evercore ISI Group Upgrades Match Group to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $53
notable.read: A rating upgrade, positive for sentiment. Earnings are estimated for 11-03.

notable.headline: UBS Maintains Buy on Tapestry, Lowers Price Target to $200
notable.read: A PT trim while keeping Buy: a minor negative.

notable.headline: Instacart Agrees To $5M Settlement With U.S. Authorities Over Alleged Discrimination In PERM Recruitment
notable.read: Immaterial in dollars; headline risk only.

notable.headline: Bitcoin Taps $83,000 as Iran Deal Hopes Lift XRP, ETH
notable.read: BTC is recovering from a ~6% correction (support ~$80.4k). IBIT posted its biggest inflow in a year, though futures demand is weak and $333.6M in liquidations hit on 10-19. On the structural side, BlackRock filed for a downside-protected BTC ETF and JPM Coin is moving to Ethereum, both positive. Regulatory risk is a slow burn: Trump-family ties are threatening the CLARITY Act. There were no exchange failures.

notable.headline: Top Economist Warns US Is 'Wildly Irresponsible' With $1.99 Trillion Deficit as Interest Costs Top Defense Spending
notable.read: The 10y is at 5.14% (10-19). Fed Chair Warsh's remarks have rate-hike odds in play, and with $110 Brent pushing inflation, the duration sleeve (TLT/IEF/BND) and VNQ face hike and term-premium risk. The deficit itself is background.

notable.headline: 408x Oversubscribed AI IPO Crashes 32%; Democratic Sweep Prospects Trigger Selling in Data Center Stocks
notable.read: AI/semis remain fragile. The SOX just snapped an 8-day losing streak, its longest since 2008, and midterm polling is now a sector risk for AI/data-center names. Iran's threat to undersea cables in Hormuz is a geopolitical tail risk for QQQ/VOO and oil. Mega-cap earnings ahead (META, TSLA, AMZN) add index event risk.
